Two fixes for an Instagram profile's **Posts** tab. Nothing changes in what the
extension reads, stores or sends.

- **The grid is sorted the first time.** Instagram sends no view counts on the
  Posts tab, not even for reels, and "Most views" was the default there, so the
  grid stayed in feed order until you picked another sort. The Posts tab now
  defaults to "Most likes". A "Most views" run sorts by likes and says so.
- **No more blank tiles.** Instagram hides each image until it has loaded, and
  tiles copied before that stayed blank in the sorted grid. The sort now waits
  for the image, and a copied tile always shows it.
